title: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B IQ3_XXS 100K q8 MTP on one RX 6900 XT (Vulkan, 3D_FULL_SCREEN)
purpose: 100K q8 MTP route with built-in draft-mtp n=3 at b512/ub256 on one RX 6900 XT via the Mesa RADV Vulkan build.
caveats: Evidence is RX 6900 XT-specific (gfx1030, Vulkan RADV Mesa 26.2.0-devel); do not generalize to RX 9070 XT or other 16GB Radeon cards.
This Vulkan route was measured under the 3D_FULL_SCREEN power profile; the COMPUTE profile rows are a separate preset lane (ROCm/HIP).
q8_0 KV is the recommendation floor for this preset; lower KV variants are exploratory only.
The seed Vulkan row under known_evidence was captured with request-level disable_thinking; it is provenance for the fit, not evidence for this candidate's thinking route.
This preset is a candidate until the uncached high-context profile (unique leading nonce, cache_prompt=false, sustained generation) passes a review.
